no_target_parameter_retuning_derivation: Computed from the complete versioned figures, graph_partition, and memory_ablation policy trees plus declared profile calibration keys. Source policy file hashes are part of the boolean. Any scheduler policy or source implementation change, including FIFO window count/size/release, makes this boolean false instead of being hidden by an allowlist.

after.policy: every PRE, ACT, READ, and WRITE event is stored in a reversible chunked stream; the validator independently reconstructs event and command totals, checksum, edge samples, channel-lane spacing, tCCD/turnaround, and bank recovery

changed_paths.after: The required FIFO baseline has no active-window resource cap: each admission cycle selects one ready Edge/Input/Weight/Output port and admits up to four consecutive blocks subject only to the same transaction and command queue capacities used by batch-class. Positive fifo_active_windows values are diagnostic counterfactuals, not paper evidence. Batch-class changes only request ordering and assembles batch-local Edge > Input > Weight > Output streams with same batch/class open-row continuation.
changed_paths.before: FIFO selects one Edge/Input/Weight/Output port per admission cycle, admits up to four consecutive blocks, and bounds the uncoordinated in-flight row windows to the four Figure 9 request sources; batch-class assembles batch-local Edge > Input > Weight > Output streams with same batch/class open-row continuation

changed_paths.after: HyGCN HPCA 2020 Figure 9 identifies four Edge, Input, Weight, and Output request sources; it does not specify four unfinished 2 KiB windows. Section 4.5.2 attributes the optimization to priority-based request reordering and low-bit channel/bank mapping.
changed_paths.before: HyGCN HPCA 2020 Figure 9 shows four concurrent Edge, Input, Weight, and Output request sources; Section 4.5.2 says the uncoordinated requests are handled sequentially and the coordinator assembles them into continuous batch-local streams before low-bit remapping

changed_paths.after: diagnostic-only when fifo_active_windows is positive; the required profile is unbounded
